subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Should this umbrella issue be split into narrower core docs/product items, and which remaining surfaces should OpenClaw own versus leave as operator scripts or existing audit/status commands?
rationale: The current code already covers several requested behaviors, while the remaining systemd, update-diff, and audit requests change stable setup/security/operator workflows and need maintainer scope before implementation.

options.title: Split Remaining Core Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the routing hub, create or point to focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff output, and audit scope, and preserve current bind/token/audit behavior where already implemented.

options.title: Sponsor A Broad CLI/Audit Expansion
options.body: Accept the combined direction and design a larger core project for systemd deployment, safe update, backup, and audit commands with explicit security and upgrade proof.

options.title: Close After Externalizing Scripts
options.body: Treat the gist scripts as operator-owned examples and close once maintainers decide OpenClaw should not add more core surfaces beyond the behavior already on main.

recommendation.title: Split Remaining Core Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the routing hub, create or point to focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diff output, and audit scope, and preserve current bind/token/audit behavior where already implemented.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the affected docs, audit, update, and dashboard auth surfaces.
